note: What a client sends as its player opens the shop. It carries nothing of its own. The header carries zero.

revisions.note: A client sends it each time the shop opens, on any map and in any mode. While input lock 16 holds, the shop does not open and it sends nothing.
A client sends it every time its player opens the shop, in any game. Where a script of the client's has locked the shop, the shop does not open and nothing is sent.
A client sends it only in the tutorial: where the version answer names the mode TUTORIAL and the map's own data marks it as a tutorial map, as map 12's does; elsewhere it never sends this.
